fusions.name: Aimed Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a spear that deals 9 damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Barbed Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 3 spears in a spread, each dealing 7 damage and knocking its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hurled Self
fusions.desc: Throws you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Point Struck
fusions.desc: Each critical hit sends a spear to the nearest enemy within 5.5 tiles, dealing 6 damage.
